target.statement: Median Spearman correlation with W2 of 0.879 for dSK (and 0.924 for WΓ) over 12 scientific collections / 227 persistence diagrams
target.dataset: 12 scientific collections of persistence diagrams (227 diagrams), e.g. Isabel, Earthquake, Ionization 2D/3D, Cloud Processes, Asteroid, Sea Surface Height, Starting Vortex

compute.basis: The metric itself is O(N log N) sorting on small diagrams, but reproducing the headline correlation requires the 12 scientific diagram collections (likely TTK-derived from simulation ensembles) plus the W2 reference matrices; if data are not bundled, diagrams must be regenerated with TTK, which is the main cost.

blockers: Diagram collections and W2 reference matrices may not be included in the repo
Regenerating diagrams requires TTK and the original simulation datasets
Repo state/version not verifiable from the paper text
title: Sierpiński--Knopp Wasserstein Distance for Persistence Diagrams and Applications to 2-Wasserstein Approximation
